reviewed_by: Claude review of the searchable Shared skills settings entry
reason: Discoverability fix in the settings catalog: Shared skills (#native-skill-settings) had no catalog entry, so searching "skills" in universal search or the phone Settings list returned nothing and the section was only reachable by guessing it sits behind the Models group. Adds settings.skills (category Models, target native-skill-settings), its row glyph, and the coverage for both surfaces the catalog feeds. ui/src/components/CompactSettingsList.test.tsx covers the new row: it filters by "skills", opens the entry with its native-skill-settings target, and now asserts every catalog entry has an icon so a future entry cannot silently fall back to the generic glyph. CommandPalette.test.tsx and AssistantSetupLinks.test.tsx are the other two consumers of settingCatalog/settingCatalogEntry and confirm the added entry does not disturb federated search or the assistant setup links. area:settings-search is a new catalog area (desktop and narrow) for the universal-search lens journeys, including the added "universal search reaches shared skills and focuses that section" test, which asserts the lens opens with the skills heading focused. area:critical-workspaces is selected because the new row changes the phone Settings render that its narrow entry captures: settings-narrow-narrow-linux.png and settings-light-narrow-linux.png are refreshed here from this PR's CI actuals, the same way #372 reconciled them. ui/playwright-impact.json maps ui/src/settingsCatalog.ts, previously unmapped and therefore a coverage_review_required fallback for any catalog change, to both areas so the next catalog edit re-checks those renders automatically.
exclusions: No full suites. No Python, Rust or API change: the entry is static UI metadata, so no Core test can observe it. area:phone-shell and area:mobile-layout (the CompactSettingsList rule's areas) are excluded: no phone-shell or mobile-layout journey renders /settings, so they would only smoke-test an unrelated shell, while the new row is covered by CompactSettingsList.test.tsx, by the narrow settings-search entry for the lens, and by the narrow critical-workspaces capture for the list itself. Only the two narrow Settings baselines move, refreshed from this PR's CI actuals (byte-identical across all three attempts); the desktop and compact captures render the full settings page, which the catalog does not feed.
